welcome.title: Welcome to Drydock
welcome.lead: Render Space Engineers blueprints and build simple hulls, all in your browser. Six quick stops show where everything lives.
welcome.note: Files are read locally and never uploaded. Replay this tour any time from {tour} in the header.
welcome.countNote: Drydock counts visits with GoatCounter: no cookies, nothing from your files. This helps me gauge interest in the project.

narrow.tooSmall: Your screen is too small for Drydock. It needs a browser window at least 1120 pixels wide, and on a smaller screen the layout will not fit.
narrow.options: Open this page on a larger screen, or continue anyway and scroll around the layout.

caption.drop: Drop a bp.sbc or a blueprint folder to open it

section.title: Cross-section
section.tipText: Use {slice} on the Y plane with Top view for deck plans. Each step moves one block (2.5 m large grid, 0.5 m small grid).

scene.offNote: Greyed-out skyboxes load from the game files. Link the game folder to use them.
scene.offTitle: Link the game folder to use this skybox

export.framed: The framed area in the viewport is what gets saved.

compose.help: Shapes evaluate top to bottom. Sizes and offsets are in blocks; a wall value hollows the shape to that thickness.
compose.saveJsonTitle: Save the shape stack as a JSON file
compose.openJsonTitle: Replace the shape stack with a saved JSON file
compose.name: Blueprint name
compose.exportNote: Downloads bp.sbc. Put it in a folder named after the blueprint inside Blueprints\local.
compose.warnBig: {blocks}, {size}. Large blueprints are slow to load and paste in the game.

sources.title: Content sources
sources.desc: Block definitions, models and textures are read from these folders, top to bottom. Later sources override earlier ones.
sources.empty: Nothing linked yet. Without a game folder only the built-in vanilla block set is available.
sources.uploadNote: Your browser asks to confirm an upload, but nothing leaves this device. Each folder is stored as a snapshot here and loads without picking again; refresh a source to update it.
sources.refreshTitle: Pick the folder again to update this snapshot

meta.torch: Torch / dedicated server instance · its Mods & Content
meta.mods: Loose mod folder · scanned for .sbc definitions

missing.title: Missing blocks
missing.desc: No linked source defines these block types. Link the game folder or the mods that contain them.

sources.title: Link your game folder
sources.body: Drydock reads models and textures from your own Space Engineers install. Until it is linked, every block draws as a plain box.

library.title: Open a blueprint
library.body: Pick one from your linked Blueprints folder, or drop a bp.sbc or a whole blueprint folder anywhere on the page.

vptools.title: Frame the shot
vptools.body: Switch perspective and orthographic, cut a cross-section, spin a turntable, or refit the ship to the frame.

tabs.title: Fine-tune the render
tabs.body: View sets the render style. Section slices the hull layer by layer. Scene picks backdrops and lighting.

export.title: Export an image
export.body: PNG, JPG or WebP up to 8K with supersampling, copy to clipboard, or a 36-frame turntable ZIP.

mode.title: Build your own hull
mode.body: Compose stacks boxes, spheres and cylinders into a hull and exports it as a bp.sbc you can paste in the game.
